description: Repos that consume compscidr/sair releases: keep the pinned sair version current. Extend alongside the language preset, e.g. ["github>compscidr/renovate-config:android-junit5", "github>compscidr/renovate-config:sair"].

customManagers.description: Workflows that fetch the sair tools with actions/checkout of compscidr/sair at a release tag (repository: compscidr/sair followed by ref: vX.Y.Z).
Gradle builds that download the sair protos and tools at a release (sairVersion=vX.Y.Z in gradle.properties).

packageRules.description: sair is pre-1.0, so every release is a patch bump; automerge them like any other patch.
